normalization_decisions: The CC0 split files remain canonical because they prevent GK face-stat mirrors from being misrepresented as outfield ability.
The source-specific PlayerStyle/PlayStyle+ distinction is preserved only when separately published; a combined field is not promoted to an inferred plus tier.
Sofifa value_eur, wage_eur, and release_clause_eur are never mapped to FUT price or budget fields.
Research-only observations may populate comparison evidence but cannot override canonical values.
